description: Every Autotask entity at the command line, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers ticket-aging, workload, unbilled-time, and account-360 questions no other Autotask tool can.

novel_features.name: Ticket aging
novel_features.description: Bucket open tickets by age so you see how stale the service desk is at a glance.

novel_features.name: Resource workload
novel_features.description: See which technicians are overloaded by open ticket and task hours before you assign more.

novel_features.name: Unbilled time
novel_features.description: Surface billable time entries not yet approved and posted for billing — money on the table.

novel_features.name: SLA breaches
novel_features.description: List open tickets past their due date or overdue for first response.

novel_features.name: Contract burn-down
novel_features.description: Show how much of each contract's hours/blocks are consumed versus purchased.

novel_features.name: Stale items
novel_features.description: Find tickets or projects with no activity in N days.

novel_features.name: Company 360
novel_features.description: One view of a company's tickets, contacts, contracts, config items, and opportunities.

novel_features.name: Project health
novel_features.description: Flag projects with overdue tasks or past end dates.

novel_features.name: What changed
novel_features.description: See what changed across tickets in the last N hours or days.

novel_features.name: Triage queue
novel_features.description: Rank open unassigned tickets by priority and age into a workable queue.

novel_features.name: Billing close reconciliation
novel_features.description: One month-end table: billable time not yet approved and posted, contract blocks consumed vs purchased, and the money left on the table.

novel_features.name: Account change delta
novel_features.description: What changed on one account since a point in time — new tickets, contract burn movement, opportunities, stale items.

novel_features.name: Retainer run-out projection
novel_features.description: Block-hour contracts ranked by percent consumed, with projected run-out dates from recent burn rate.

novel_features.name: Referential-integrity gaps
novel_features.description: Find tickets with no contract, time entries with no ticket, contacts and config items with no company.

novel_features.name: Picklist value resolver
novel_features.description: Print the label-to-ID map for any picklist field (status, priority, queue) from cached field metadata.
